displayName: Vertex AI suggestions: throttled or failing (429/5xx)

documentation.content: Extractor v2 (`google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite`, ADR-006 amendment 10) answered with HTTP 429 (Google's shared pool is busy) or 5xx at least 3 times in 15 minutes, in any location. Customers still get their reference; their report falls back to an incomplete handoff, and the Worker's circuit breaker skips the model while 3 of the last 5 calls fail. Check `SELECT outcome, llm_calls, count(*) FROM handoff_suggestion_runs GROUP BY 1, 2` on D1 and Vertex's quota page. Source: scripts/gcp/monitoring/README.md.

conditions.displayName: 429 or 5xx responses for gemini-3.5-flash-lite, 3 or more in 15 min

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "aiplatform.googleapis.com/PublisherModel" AND resource.labels.model_user_id = "gemini-3.5-flash-lite" AND metric.type = "aiplatform.googleapis.com/publisher/online_serving/model_invocation_count" AND metric.labels.response_code = monitoring.regex.full_match("429|5[0-9][0-9]")
